request.state:
L01: Sow the seed in trays on a windowsill in March.
L02: Keep the compost damp and never wet.
L03: Thin the seedlings when they carry two true leaves.
L04: Pot them on into small pots at the end of April.
L05: Harden them off over a fortnight.
L06: Hardening off means longer outside each day.
L07: Nothing goes into open ground before the fifteenth of May in this valley.
L08: Space the plants a foot apart.
L09: Water at the root and not on the leaf.
L10: Feed once a fortnight from midsummer.
L11: Pick often and the plant keeps giving.
L12: Pull the plants up when the first frost blackens them.

q1.instructions: Which line gives the date after which the seedlings can go outside?
